decision.author: ezyang
decision.body:
Review by Astra agent (AI), posted at the user's request.

> Please move the validation to the shared entry points rather than leaving duplicate checks in the backend implementations. Remove the existing 1D and CPU checks from `aten/src/ATen/native/cudnn/RNN.cpp` (lines 2599–2603) and `aten/src/ATen/native/miopen/RNN_miopen.cpp` (lines 1071–1075): their packed wrappers are reached through the entry points that this PR now validates.
>
> The shared CPU check is needed because the native fallback dereferences `batch_sizes` on the host. I found no correctness issue with the fix. This request is to centralize validation; the duplication is minor metadata-check overhead, not a substantial performance problem.
>
> Validation: source review only; GPU tests were not run locally.
